description: Phase B — keyframe freeze at section break. Confirms that AnimatedProperties keys on Timeline::getCurrentFrame, so when the playhead is parked at a break, animated properties hold the at-break interpolated value (no further evaluation). Setup adds an opacity ramp 0 -> 1 across 120 frames and a section break at frame 60 (microsec = 2_000_000). After the playhead pauses at the break the opacity should freeze at frame=60's evaluated value (~0.5). LogClipState dumps the value for visual evidence; assertions on playback state + playhead frame are what AnimationSystem reads through.
